ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the x-axis is Time, and the y-axis is Number of survivors. The curve starts from the lower left, label 1 is near the initial low-level portion, label 2 is on the more slowly rising slope, label 3 is near the continuing upward curved segment, the arrow of label 4 points to a section of the curve that rapidly becomes steeper and grows upward in an approximately J shape, and label 5 is located near the nearly horizontal environmental resistance/plateau. Then reason: The typical visual feature of the exponential growth stage is that the growth rate continuously accelerates, and the curve is rapidly steepening, convex upward, or J-shaped. The part in the figure that fits this feature is the sharply rising curve section pointed to by label 4, so the answer is 4.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph visually: find which numbered part lies on a rapidly steepening, convex upward curve. Compare the labeled regions with the defining visual form of exponential growth. The segment marked 4 is the one on the sharply rising J-shaped curve, so select 4.
